name: Recovered unassigned Governor: one official reassignment attempt

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.EnemyProgress()~='RECOVERED' then error('native Governor not recovered and unassigned') end; return b.CheckEnemy('RECOVERED')

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.enemyLast; if a=='ERROR_REASSIGN' or a=='UNKNOWN_REASSIGN' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_REASSIGN' or a=='REJECTED_REASSIGN'
